name: Pokémon Origins
storyline:
You wake up in a small village, realising that you have lost your memories… The people who have taken you in explain that you are in a refugee camp. The region of Elenos is ravaged by a conflict between four powerful organisations, the Brotherhoods, each of which worships an element: Water, Earth, Wind and Fire. In search of your memories and moved by the plight of these people, you decide to oppose these organisations and do everything in your power to restore freedom to Elenos.

Your destiny is to throw yourself into this conflict and champion your newly acquired ideals of freedom. But… Will the desire to understand your origins prove stronger than the desire for freedom?

Who are you really?
summary: Pokémon Origins is a fan game created using RPG Maker XP. It can be played on any Windows computer.
